text.p: ValuJet Airlines said Thursday it received persmission from the U.S. Department of Transportation and the Federal Aviation Administration to operate charter flights between Atlanta and Dallas/Fort Worth, Fort Myers and West Palm Beach, Florida between December 19 and January 6.

The company said it had called on Kiwi International Airlines, Spirit Airlines and Sun Pacific International to operate the flights at their regularly scheduled times providing service for customers who would otherwise be displaced or inconvenienced.
ValuJet said it had arranged for the following flights to be operated Thursday:
2:10 p.m. Flight 183 Atlanta - West Palm Beach
4:15 p.m. Flight 184 West Palm Beach - Atlanta
6:30 p.m. Flight 185 Atlanta - West Palm Beach
8:30 p.m. Flight 186 West Palm Beach - Atlanta
Flights between Atlanta and these three cities will be operated according to the ValuJet schedule from December 20 to January 6, it said.
